posts.text: Sanghvi Movers stock took an 13.72% dive today, and looking under the hood of their latest quarterly results, the market’s reaction makes perfect sense. At first glance, their revenue grew a healthy 32%. However, the actual quality of those earnings is quite poor. Almost half of their net profit this quarter came from non-core items, including a one-time insurance claim. Without that padding, their core operating margins actually shrank.
